name: Longwood

dates.note: The survey's inventory line reads 'Date of Erection About I860 or Earlier' and the Library's item record prints 'ca. 1860 Initial Construction'. The Wikipedia infobox instead prints 'Built 1859-ca. 1864' and the node's own exemplar says designed 1859 and halted in 1861. All are recorded; none is resolved. The survey's own condition line dates the stoppage without dating it: 'Present Condition flair (Work stopped at outbreak of Civil War and has never been touched again.)'

note: Tranche 2, Gothic Revival and picturesque villa cluster, 5 Sep 2026. Two data pages, and they are an inventory form: it states materials, storeys and an architect and states no dimension at all, so this record carries one measurement and it is a count. The Library's item record prints this in its `rights_information` field; an internal run of spaces in the JSON has been collapsed to one and nothing else was changed. It is the boilerplate the Library prints on every HABS item alike and no licence is read out of it.
